title: Atman: a standalone Rust CLI for reproducible proteomics analysis
description: Atman is a standalone Rust command-line tool for proteomics analysis. A single local binary exposes `ingest`, `validate`, `qc`, `report`, `matrix`, `fold-change`, `de`, `asymmetry`, `robustness`, `module-trajectory`, and `module-de` subcommands. The built-in ingest path supports Olink Explore NPX long CSV files, while downstream commands operate on Atman's canonical TSV schema so adapters can provide data from other proteomics sources such as LFQ/intensity matrices, Spectronaut exports, DIA-NN protein-group matrices, SomaScan-style log2 abundance matrices, or already-normalized protein tables. Version 1.0.0 reproduces the Dube et al. 2023 Olink Explore heat-acclimation dataset's published filtered NPX files cell-exactly and log2 fold-change tables to floating-point precision using the bundled fixture data.
